$comment: The Writ (docs/design/holding.md "The Writ"). GAME DESIGN's starting values (M2 Task 4a). sliverHours: one wild sliver's charge; capacityHours: a full Writ (three slivers; "a full Writ holds six" days); feeds: slivers' worth per item, by item id (only these can be fed); lowHours: under this the Writ flickers and the chip turns ember; pressChargeHours: the charge a Writ is pressed with when its row is created ("keeps its name two days"; it drains normally from then, so a Writ never fed goes dark after two days); graceHoursCertified and graceHoursUncertified: dark, but the island still remembers itself (both 48 until the Wet House opens in M4, whose task sets the uncertified one to 24); lineFadeHours: after the grace, one line fades each such stretch, outermost first; lineLetters: letters a Writ line holds (the lean hand, letters.md "Hearing a Name"); linePlots: plots each line tethers. flickerPatternMs: ART's (on #91), the flicker while low as ms of the outer letters lit, then dim, then lit…, repeating: uneven, a guttering lamp rather than a steady blink. GAME DESIGN's answers of 2026-10-18.
